failure_summary.description: Agents favored a salient keyword or nearby association over the clue’s defining details, requested role, or slogan referent, despite existing guidance.
The correct series was identified, but the answer used its longer full title instead of the expected short label.
A bare list of character names was treated as a request for their category rather than the associated show.

patch.reasoning: The main failures are already covered by rules to verify every defining clue detail, resolve the requested relation, reject category mismatches, and use the shortest complete label. The remaining bare-list case is under-specified, and a similar broad prompt-inference edit was rejected in a previous step; adding another general rule would risk duplication without reliable benefit.
